correctness.rationale: The left Leibniz bracket is [x,y]=beta(x)alpha(y)e1. A bracket-preserving map sends e1 to ae1. For a!=0 the endomorphism has forced e2 coefficient one and central W map, and idempotence yields a=1,B^2=B, Bv=0; nonabelian retract rank r+2 has q^(m-r)I_m(r) cases. For a=0 images lie in one of two maximal abelian hyperplanes H1 and H2; their rank-k retractions contribute q^(2k)I_m(k) and I_(m+1)(k) with intersection q^k I_m(k), yielding the stated formula. The fixed-field asymptotic follows from Gaussian projection concentration near (m+1)/2, overlap and nonabelian terms lower by q^{-m/2}, and the theta(q) discrete Gaussian. Independently exhaustively enumerated all 4x4 GF2 linear maps for m=2 and checked the defining bracket and idempotence directly: ranks {0:1,1:40,2:44,3:13,4:1}. Mathematically valid, but not original.
